description: This file contains functions for managing routing bindings, including normalization, listing, and resolution of account and agent IDs, as well as building channel-account mappings.

methods.name: normalizeBindingChannelId
methods.description: Normalizes a raw channel ID, providing a fallback to trimmed lowercase string or null.

methods.name: listBindings
methods.description: Returns a list of route bindings based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: resolveNormalizedBindingMatch
methods.description: Resolves a binding to its agentId, accountId, and channelId if valid.

methods.name: listBoundAccountIds
methods.description: Lists account IDs bound to a specific channel ID.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentBoundAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the account ID bound to the default agent for a given channel.

methods.name: buildChannelAccountBindings
methods.description: Builds a nested map of channel IDs to agent IDs to account IDs.

methods.name: resolvePreferredAccountId
methods.description: Selects the preferred account ID from bound accounts or defaults.
